scripts.api:dev: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --reload
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.check: npm run check:node && npm run api:test
scripts.check:node: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
